rules.statement: A person affected by void proceedings can apply to have them set aside ex debito justitiae in the exercise of the inherent jurisdiction of the court.
rules.supporting_quote: The proceedings being void, the person affected by them can apply to have them set aside ex debito justitiae in the exercise of the inherent jurisdiction of the court which is saved by S. 839 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: S. 839 of the Civil Procedure Code
